narrative.overview:
마이브러리 (Mybrary) is a personal capture box, not a knowledge base. The surface is a warm enamel fridge door: rubber gasket, stainless handle, Jeju tangerine (hallabong) disc magnets, and paper clippings of uneven size. You open the door (header 로그인, then Apple / Google / Browse), read the recency door, and stick from a bottom dock. What you stick snaps onto the door already tagged.

The product is Operate-mode. Brand lives in material details (gasket, magnets, clipping rotation) while controls stay familiar. Korean and English share one layout. Auth sits in a header sheet. Light is a peach porcelain kitchen; dark is a night kitchen. The pressable magnet is Jeju tangerine by default, or Jeju basalt when that palette is on.
keyCharacteristics: Intro is the first public surface on porcelain peach / night kitchen (celadon if AI); peach kitchen shows before the door opens
Header auth sheet is the white doorstep (light) or night enamel (dark)
Centered capture column on every breakpoint
Soft rounded clippings (18px), not razor-square paper and not identical SaaS cards
Recency list to read; Stick docked at the thumb
Personal voice: stick, peel, empty the door

rules.name: The One Magnet Rule
rules.body: One accent at a time. It marks the thing you can press or the tag that names a type. It does not wash backgrounds.

rules.name: The Two Magnets Rule
rules.body: Default magnet is hallabong tangerine. 현무암 swaps that accent to Jeju basalt charcoal. Do not retint enamel, paper, or the kitchen wall when testing basalt. Sample photo SVGs must read --magnet (or the matching hex) at paint time; do not bake #e56f0a. The 견본 tag is hairline ink, not danger orange.

rules.name: The Stick Dock Rule
rules.body: After the door opens, Stick is a bottom dock on every palette (기본, 현무암, AI). Search and the recency list sit above it. Classify draft sits above the field, still in the dock. Intro has no dock. Do not put the composer back above the list.

rules.name: The AI Comparison Rule
rules.body: Header AI opens a second surface: celadon accent, cooler ground, and an editorial magazine feed. The bottom Stick dock is shared with the fridge palettes. Header and footer chrome stay. Fridge collage, magnet dots, and tilted paper do not. It is not a purple chat or zinc-blue SaaS skin. Switch back to 기본 or 현무암 to judge the incumbent fridge.

rules.name: The White Doorstep
rules.body: The doorstep is a header auth sheet (light: white; dark: night enamel). The intro sits on porcelain peach / night kitchen. Dark intro is not a white flash.

rules.name: The Cave Check
rules.body: Light kitchen wall stays porcelain peach (#fff7f2 → #f3e7de). Dark mode is a night kitchen (#2a2622 → #1f1c19), not #0c0b0a. If a fill looks like printer toner, lift it. Muted copy must stay AA on enamel (≥4.5:1): light #6e665c on #fff7f2 (~5.4:1); dark #c5b8a8 on #302b26 (~7.2:1).

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Do not pair a Latin display serif or Inter-like default with SUIT. Hangul and English share the same cuts.

rules.name: The Offset Rule
rules.body: Shadows carry offset and blur. A colored halo is not depth.

rules.name: The Focus Follows Form Rule
rules.body: Every focusable control has a radius from the scale. The tangerine companion ring is box-shadow so it follows that radius. Composer shell stays --radius-lg (24px) so it sits with the 14px + and Stick. Focus is that shell, not a square on the textarea, and not a pill that fights the inner buttons.

rules.name: The Quiet Door Rule
rules.body: Motion is short and decelerates. Nothing loops except the OG skeleton sheen. No bounce, no page-wide parallax, no confetti.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: One transition at a time for a given surface: intro hands off to the app, the draft exits before the new clipping snaps on, the + menu and header sheets close before another overlay opens.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion Rule
rules.body: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns off animation and transition, including hover-play on video/audio. Instant show/hide. Smooth scroll becomes auto. First paint after a saved session never plays the door-open motion.

rules.name: The Open Kitchen Rule
rules.body: First visit is an intro that shows the fridge job. Auth does not own the first viewport. Apple / Google / Browse live in the header. Browse and sign-in both open the door. A saved session still skips intro.

rules.name: The Demo Is The Product Rule
rules.body: Intro scenes show stick, classify, and find as fridge-door stills (porcelain enamel, tangerine magnets, paper clippings) labeled 견본 / Sample. One line of copy under each still. Do not invent customers, download counts, testimonials, or AI claims. Do not build a purple SaaS landing, a phone farm of fake UI, or CSS widgets that impersonate the composer.

rules.name: The Day Magnet Rule
rules.body: 일자별 is a filter on the recency list, not a calendar product and not a second home. Counts are scraps stuck that local calendar day (createdAt). One selected day at a time. Combine with type, tag, and search. Inside a day, newest first.

rules.name: The Korean Footer Rule
rules.body: Intro and app show operator identity plus 이용약관 plus 개인정보처리방침. Privacy is easier to spot than the other links (bold or magnet). Placeholders until real operator data. Do not invent a 사업자등록번호 or 통신판매업 신고번호. 비우기 stays an app-only footer action.

dos: Speak like a personal box: stick, peel, empty the door, this device.
Show the media itself (image, hover-play, OG, PDF first page).
Label synthetic scraps as Sample / 견본.
Keep KO and EN on one layout.
Use the type / icon / control scale. Do not invent a one-off size.
Keep fills inside the Cave Check. Porcelain peach kitchen, night kitchen, not toner. The header auth sheet is white in light mode.
Keep two-step confirms for peel, Leave-with-draft, and Empty.
Put auth in the header and counts on the day grid, not in a new information architecture.
donts: Build a Notion sidebar of equal cards, or a purple AI chat on cream.
Use Inter, Space Grotesk, IBM Plex, Outfit, Plus Jakarta, DM Sans, or Instrument Sans as the UI face.
Put camera on fine-pointer desktop as a dead control.
Invent team, workspace, or research-lab language.
Turn 일자별 into a scheduling calendar, heatmap product, or folders-by-month.
Ship a login wall as the first page.
